note: Patients with isolated point/truncating PSMD12 mutations exhibit the complete triad of developmental delay/intellectual disability, craniofacial dysmorphism, and skeletal abnormalities.

evidence.text: Six individuals from two unrelated families carrying intragenic truncating PSMD12 variants (p.Arg289* or p.Tyr111*) all presented with developmental delay, intellectual disability, craniofacial, and skeletal anomalies, confirming complete penetrance of the core triad without contiguous deletions.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating  PSMD12  Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: Portraying a completely penetrant condition with inter- and intra-familiar clinical variability, all individuals presented with developmental delay, intellectual disability, craniofacial, and skeletal anomalies.

evidence.text: Patients with truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions of PSMD12 both manifest core features including developmental delay/intellectual disability, facial dysmorphism, and hand/skeletal malformations.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: We report 24 additional unrelated patients with STISS with various truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions involving PSMD12.
